gr-xendit-8204620003.d:
Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.

About the Job

At Xendit, we are seeking a Senior Product Manager - Cards to help shape and scale our card acquiring product. You will join our growing cards team, working closely with our existing Cards product lead and reporting to the Product Director, Payments Acceptance. In this role, you will own card acquiring initiatives end to end, from authorisation and processing flows to connections with acquirers and card schemes, and help define our acquiring strategy, including licensing and acquirer partnerships. You will also work to improve authorisation rates and manage chargebacks and settlement.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of product management experience, or a strong track record in card products, with a strong focus on execution and strategy
• Hands-on card acquiring experience, ideally at a card acquirer processing Visa and Mastercard transactions
• Ability to independently own card acquiring initiatives from day one
• Technical fluency to understand how payment systems work together (e.g. APIs, authorisation and settlement flows)
• Experience working across multiple regions and regulatory jurisdictions
• Metrics-minded, having owned key metrics for your product area (e.g. authorisation rate, TPV, margin)
• Experience building B2B products or integrating B2B offerings

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience launching global products
• Clear understanding of card economics (e.g. interchange, scheme fees, acquiring margin)
• Experience partnering with card schemes (Visa, Mastercard) from the acquirer side
• Experience with card licensing or connecting to new acquirers

Responsibilities

• Own and evolve card acquiring and processing flows, including authorisation, capture and refunds
• Manage and expand Xendit's connections to acquirers and card schemes (Visa, Mastercard)
• Help shape Xendit's acquiring strategy, including licensing and acquirer partnerships
• Improve authorisation rates and manage chargeback and settlement performance
• Define and own key metrics for your area, such as authorisation rate, TPV and margin
• Spend time with merchants to understand their card payment needs and turn them into clear product requirements
• Partner with Engineering, Risk, Finance and commercial teams to deliver card products on time and to a high standard

su-isat-61041744.d:
Role Purpose

Lead FTTH and FWA annual operating planning, financial outlooks, and business case evaluation, providing clear analysis for VP review and supporting management and shareholder decisions on profitable growth and investments.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) for FTTH and FWA, aligning subscriber, revenue, operating cost, CapEx, profitability, and cash flow targets with business strategy and execution plans.
• Lead periodic financial outlooks, including 3+9, 6+6, and 9+3 forecasts, incorporating actual performance, updated assumptions, risks, and opportunities; explain variances against the AOP and recommend actions to close gaps.
• Lead business case development and investment appraisal for FTTH rollout and partnerships, assessing home-pass potential, take-up rates, contractual commitments, financial returns, and capital efficiency.
• Evaluate FWA investment and commercial models, aligning network capacity, customer demand, device lifecycle costs, and deployment readiness; oversee scenario and sensitivity analyses across FTTH and FWA.
• Coordinate cross-functional inputs and prepare shareholder presentations, management reports, responses to stakeholder inquiries, and ad hoc analyses, ensuring clear insights and recommendations for VP review before submission.
• Oversee performance against approved plans and business cases, drive corrective actions with business owners, maintain planning and investment governance, and guide the Senior Officer’s work.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline.
• At least seven years of relevant experience in business planning, commercial finance, investment analysis, or consulting, including experience leading projects or analytical teams.
• Proven experience leading annual budgets, AOP development, and periodic financial forecasts.
• Strong expertise in financial modelling, investment appraisal, cash flow analysis, NPV, IRR, and scenario assessment.
• Experience evaluating telecommunications or broadband investments, with an understanding of FTTH and FWA business models and economics.
• Proven ability to challenge assumptions, align cross-functional stakeholders, and translate complex analysis into clear management and shareholder presentations.
• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and business communication skills.
• Experience using AI tools to support financial analysis, market research, scenario modelling, and presentation preparation is an added advantage, with the ability to independently validate outputs and protect confidential business data.
